title: Jerome, Commentary on Daniel (trans. Gleason L. Archer, 1958) — chapter 7
license: Page states: "All material on this page is in the public domain"; paraphrased

verification_log.method: Downloaded and read the chapter 7 commentary

Four beasts = Babylonians, Persians (Medes and Persians), Macedonians, Romans; ten horns = ten kings partitioning the Roman world at the end; little horn = Antichrist, a man indwelt by Satan; Porphyry made the leopard Alexander, the fourth beast his successors, ten cruel kings up to Antiochus Epiphanes, and the little horn Antiochus; son of man = the Son of God; time = year, times = two years; "Away, then, with the fable about a millennium"
